acip: BAm YIG DANG AOm GSUM MAS LHA DE RNAMS MTSON TE, BAm YIG ZHIG PA NA AA THUNG YA RA LA WA LNGAR 'GYUR LA, AA THUNG GIS RNAL 'BYOR MA, YAS L'A MA, RAS DUM SKYES MA, LAS GZUGS CAN MA, WAS MKHA' 'GRO MA STE BDE CHEN 'KHOR LO'I YUM LNGA,
wylie: baM yig dang aoM gsum mas lha de rnams mtshon te, baM yig zhig pa na aa thung ya ra la wa lngar 'gyur la, aa thung gis rnal 'byor ma, yas lA ma, ras dum skyes ma, las gzugs can ma, was mkha' 'gro ma ste bde chen 'khor lo'i yum lnga
english: The letter vam and the secret words of the triple om represent all of these Angels.  The vam can be broken down into its five component letters: the short a, the ya, ra, la, and va.  These represent the five Angels of the inner flower of great bliss: the short a stands for the Holy Angel, the ya for the Lady of La, the ra for the Lady of Pieces, the la for the Lady of Forms, and the va for the Lady of the Sky.
